playbookOutputs: Completed Municipal / Eskom Small-Scale Embedded Generation (SSEG) Application & Commissioning Pack
Compiled Technical Dossier (NRS 097-2-1, CoC, Single-Line Diagram & Bi-Directional Meter Request)
playbookCommonFailures: Installed hybrid/grid-tie inverter model does not appear on the municipality approved NRS 097-2-1 inverter list
Single-Line Diagram (SLD) or commissioning report lacks ECSA-registered Professional Engineer / Technologist sign-off required by the municipality

informationToProvide.label: Municipal / Eskom Electricity Account Bill
informationToProvide.aiHint: Recent electricity utility bill showing account and meter number.

informationToProvide.label: Inverter Make, Model, Rating & Serial Number
informationToProvide.aiHint: E.g., Deye 8kW Hybrid / Sunsynk 8.8kW / Victron with NRS 097-2-1 certification.

informationToProvide.label: Total Solar Panel Installed Capacity (kWp)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Total peak kilowatt wattage of installed solar panels.

informationToProvide.label: Property Owner Certified ID Copy (< 3 Months) & CIPC CoR 14.3 (If Commercial/Company Property)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the property owner certified ID (< 3 months) and, if registered in a company name, the CoR 14.3 and proxy letter.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified ID of the property owner and CIPC CoR 14.3 if owned by a company.

informationToProvide.label: Electrical Certificate of Compliance (CoC), Single-Line Diagram (SLD) & Inverter NRS 097-2-1 Certificate
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the electrical CoC issued by your solar installer, the Single-Line Diagram (SLD), and the NRS 097-2-1 certificate for your inverter.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Electrical Certificate of Compliance (CoC), Single-Line Diagram (SLD), and NRS 097-2-1 compliance certificate for the installed PV inverter.

informationToProvide.label: Municipality / Utility Name (e.g. City Power, City of Cape Town, eThekwini, Tshwane, Eskom) & Solar Installer Contact Details
informationToProvide.helpText: State which municipality or Eskom region supplies electricity to the property and provide your solar installer / electrician name, DoEL number, email, and phone number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify inverter approval & utility account
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Inverter checked against municipality approved list, account confirmed

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Compile municipal SSEG application and technical dossier
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application form, SLD checklist, and inverter test certs compiled

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver SSEG pack to client or submit to municipality portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application submitted or delivered with municipal lodging instructions
